description: This file defines the JFontChooser class, a custom Java Swing dialog for selecting fonts, including font family, size, style (bold/italic), and displaying a sample text.

classes.name: JFontChooser
classes.description: A Swing dialog for font selection, allowing users to choose font family, size, and style, with a sample display.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Displays the font chooser dialog and returns the user's selection result.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the current font in the dialog, updating UI components accordingly.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Returns the selected font if OK was pressed; otherwise null.

methods.name: getCurrentFont
methods.description: Constructs and returns the font based on current selections.
